capabilities: embed Telegram Web in an Obsidian sidebar
open a configured default bot, user, or channel on launch
open, reload, and navigate chats via commands
configure web version, panel side, and auto-open behavior
extras: Installable only via BRAT; requires Obsidian Desktop and is not compatible with Obsidian Mobile; flagged as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Checking Telegram messages while working in Obsidian requires switching to a separate window or app.
summary: Sidebar plugin that embeds the full Telegram Web client in an Electron webview for chatting without leaving the vault.
